system.description:
The smugglers of the Jinia Isles and the Opal docks: cargo, hidden holds and quick exits.

  • Smuggler's Stash: on a ship, cart or wagon you find its hidden compartments with 1 minute of searching and no check, and can hide up to 2 slots of goods there that a search finds only by beating your Pick Pocket check. Climbing rigging never needs a check. After your Exploit hits, you can move 10ft as part of the same action without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
    • 9th level: you may move 20ft instead, climbing as you go without a check.
  • Dockside Charm: Advantage on checks to bribe or bargain with port officials.
